name: Raelda Le Failda
original_name: ラエルダ・レ・ファイルーダ
source:
[u][b]The Dignified Dark Elf Oppai Bunny!♥[/b][/u]
Race: Dark Elf (Eupho Rubia Tribe)
Second Year at Lepus Rabirio Bunny Academy
Bikini Knights Club Captain

Raelda is a 2nd-year student at Lepus Rabirio Bunny Academy and a girl from the Dark Elf tribe. [url=/c146737]Alice[/url], a High Elf, is her close friend due to their shared Elven background, though they’re always bickering whenever they meet. (A love-hate relationship like a dog and monkey!?)

She struggles with social interactions, is inexperienced in love, and has a serious, inflexible personality. When the protagonist makes dirty jokes, she sometimes reacts by reaching for her sword, radiating an intimidating aura like she’s about to punish him for lacking “experience points.”

However, she has a soft side and can’t refuse when people depend on her. She’s especially weak when someone says, “It has to be Raelda or it wont do!”

When it comes to romance, she seems to get oddly flustered whenever Alice and the protagonist flirt in front of her. Apparently, she’s actually quite interested in love and the opposite sex. (A masochistic tsundere perv!?)

She also has a rather skewed sense of shame compared to normal girls and sometimes confides her embarrassing troubles to the protagonist without much hesitation.

She’s the captain of the “Bikini Knights,” a club she belongs to. (The “Bikini Knights” is a club created by the protagonist within the game’s world.) The protagonist often visits the clubroom just to sneak peeks at Raelda’s well-trained chest.

Her interests are surprisingly girly. Despite her cool, logical nature—traits that even led to her getting pulled into another world—she’s fond of things like cute animals and fortune-telling. (She often fails at disarming traps.)

Catchphrase: “I would never fall into a trap!!”
